Never deploy to production without explicit operator approval.
Keep answers short and plain. No essays unless asked.
Always write tests for new ranking or bank logic.
Use JSON files for the clean-room bank. Do not use SQLite.
Cursor hooks must never call 8811. Agents call recall themselves.
Never paste API keys, tokens, or passwords into chat.
Create git commits only when the operator explicitly asks.
Run product python from the repo .venv, not a random system interpreter.
The product HTTP server listens on 127.0.0.1 port 8812 not desk 8811.
MCP tools are exactly health, guidance_commit, guidance_recall, guidance_deactivate.
Before acting on a task where stored guidance may matter, call guidance_recall.
Guidance ranking is code. Do not use an LLM to judge ranker scores.
Bank writes must be atomic replace plus a last-good bak snapshot.
Reset is allowed only on a bank whose role is demo.
Do not claim Done or PASS. Operator eyes decide.
Brand accent is cyan. Do not use magenta on the product site.
Do not auto-speak on Pocket unless the operator asks this turn.
Never zip the operator desk as a product.
Logs must not contain bearer tokens or API keys.
Project Alpha uses FastAPI for the public HTTP surface.
Project Beta uses Flask for the public HTTP surface.
Apply database migrations before starting the API process.
Pocket UI stays a phone column. Do not widen to 100vw.
Do not skip tests to make a ranking change look green.
Export a bank backup before any destructive reset.
Call health before claiming the product server is up.
Recall must echo the caller query string unchanged in the response.
Superseded, retracted, test, and plan_meta records must not rank in normal recall.
The same bank and query must return the same hit order every time.
Do not claim scale beyond measured latency on this machine.
Model obedience is not retrieval accuracy. Score them apart.
A screen recording is not product evidence. Files and hashes are.
Bootstrap must work when the checkout path contains spaces.
Developer v1 targets Python 3.11 or newer.
Product HTTP is POST /api/dimensional. GET is not an API.
Locks refuse actions. Taste shapes wording. Do not mix those jobs.
A durable coding standard outranks a newer unrelated UI note.
When speaking to the operator, call him Viss.
Overnight ticks stay silent. Do not auto Pocket TTS overnight.
Do not expose the product server on a public unauthenticated tunnel.
The people product bank is JSON files. It does not require Qdrant.
The people product ranker does not call an embedding API.
Do not mix stock Cursor settings with the Godmode fork.
Do not wire Stripe in this product slice.
The WATCH film is not a retrieval receipt.
Public receipts live in the site repo proof folder, not private source.
After editing mcp.json, reload MCP. A stale stdio process is not a bank failure.
Do not bind two products to the same loopback port.
Try a blue button on the settings page this afternoon.
Run ruff on changed Python files before claiming a patch is clean.
Format Python with black using the repo default line length.
Do not add new untyped public functions in the product package.
Outbound product HTTP calls use a 30 second timeout.
Bank files are UTF-8 JSON with a trailing newline.
Record ids are UUID strings. Do not invent short slugs as ids.
Default recall limit is 6 hits unless the caller sets limit.
Empty bank recall_status is empty_bank with suggestion calibration_needed.
Bind the product server to 127.0.0.1 not 0.0.0.0.
Windows launchers run under pwsh not Windows PowerShell 5 when possible.
Bootstrap installs pytest into the product venv.
This product is a paid license. See LICENSE.
CLI backup writes a timestamped JSON under the bank backups folder by default.
CLI restore replaces the live bank from a backup JSON.
Health fingerprint includes sha256 bytes count and role.
